hero.title: About DROS
hero.subtitle: We do not just constrain large models. We are the Root CA and PKI trust foundation for the Agentic Web.
hero.desc: In the frantic race toward AGI, autonomous Agents are emerging everywhere. However, if hijacked or rogue, they will execute illegal transfers or breaches without human footprints—a traceless crisis. DROS exists to sign non-repudiable capability credentials, melting risks physically at the C-ABI bottleneck.

philosophy.title: Our Philosophy: Determinism > Probability
philosophy.desc:
We disdain patching 'hallucinations' by layering dozens of microservices, massive Vector DBs, and endless Prompt Engineering. True security should never be built on guesswork and probabilities.

We advocate for returning to OS-level primitives. Instead of trying to make the AI 'understand' the rules, we use pure memory mapping and bitwise operations to physically melt dangerous boundaries at runtime, establishing clear Agent Accountability.

origin.title: Name Origin: Dharma Reasoning
origin.desc:
Driven by a deep passion for Buddhism, DROS began as the Dharma Reasoning Operating System—an open-source AI infrastructure designed to eliminate hallucinations and preserve the purity of Buddhist teachings. We open-sourced this core on GitHub to allow public scrutiny and offer it for free to anyone seeking the Dharma.

During this process, we unexpectedly discovered that this exact deterministic core could be applied to solve the broader, critical enterprise problems of AI hallucinations and Prompt Injections. This realization led us to develop our first commercial product: VajraClaw.

niche.title: Positioning: The Root CA of the Agentic Web
niche.desc:
We occupy a highly unique ecological niche in the AI supply chain:

1. We do not compete with OpenAI or Anthropic: We do not train foundational models.
2. We do not covet enterprise secrets: We are a Zero-Telemetry physical component.

We act as the neutral Capability Certificate Authority (Root CA) and physical Inspection Station. Agents must carry a signed `policy.bin` credential to interact across servers, which nodes verify offline in 484.8ns, eliminating anonymous execution threats.

vision.title: Ultimate Vision: From Execution Governance to Agent Accountability
vision.desc: Just as SSL/TLS certificates secure host trust and OAuth secures human identity, the DROS Vajra Contract will serve as the capability credential mesh for the Agentic Web. Our vision is to transition from basic 'execution governance' to absolute 'agent accountability', wrapping every agent in a non-repudiable cryptographic seal.
